status: exploratory; fixed after finding candidate witnesses, not preregistered
hypothesis: If a bridge singleton (within any text), or its exact complete bridge text, is a context-independent label for the object motif, every motif-labelled non-copper occurrence must have a source label present in the copper discovery set.
exclusions: Reject incomplete, non-simple, unknown-token and non-R/L texts using parse_lipi; permit NR only for a literal singleton. No variant merges, no text reversal.
domain: All sites and types in the same pinned export; targets exclude TAB:C and every discovery artifact. Secondary source reuse is not independent archaeological replication.
deduplication: One occurrence per artifact, exact ordered sequence, literal motif label, object type. Keep alternative labels visible rather than collapse them.
quality_sensitivity: Rebuild discovery bridges and repeat transfer with Good/Fair rows only on every contributing object.
interpretive_limits: Tests source-label transfer, not animal-word semantics.
Literal label differences may reflect annotation differences or object-level/face-level assignment.
No missing target label counts as a success or failure.
Absence of outside-domain occurrences leaves a candidate untested.
No formal p-value; very small target sample and protocol selected after inspection.
